name: Public Health
title: Public Health Professional
introduction: Public Health professionals work on population-level health — preventing disease outbreaks, running immunisation programmes and shaping health policy for millions.
whoShouldPursue: Students who want healthcare impact at scale
Those drawn to policy and programmes

workNature.description: Public health professionals run health programmes, track outbreaks and analyse health data for governments and agencies.

eligibility: MBBS/BDS/any degree + MPH (Master of Public Health)

stats.futureOutlook: Post-COVID, public health infrastructure investment has grown sharply in India — MPH graduates are in demand across government missions and global agencies.

steps.title: MPH
steps.description: Master of Public Health from recognised institutions.

seo.title: Public Health Career in India: MPH Salary, Jobs & Scope
seo.description: Public Health career guide for India — MPH degree, government jobs, NGO roles and salary.

faqs.question: What does a public health professional do?
faqs.answer: They run population-level health programmes, track outbreaks and shape health policy.

faqs.question: Is MPH only for doctors?
faqs.answer: No — any graduate can pursue MPH, though medical background helps.

deg: MBBS/BDS/Any degree + MPH (Master of Public Health)
env: Government health missions, WHO/UNICEF-type agencies, NGOs and research institutes; field work

name: Hospital Administration
title: Hospital Administrator
introduction: Hospital Administrators run the business side of hospitals — operations, quality accreditation, billing and patient flow — so doctors can focus on care.

workNature.description: Hospital administrators manage departments, ensure accreditation compliance and optimise patient flow.

stats.futureOutlook: Hospital chains are expanding across tier-2/3 cities, and quality accreditation is becoming mandatory — administrators are in demand.

steps.title: Operations Entry
steps.description: Join hospital chains in operations roles.

seo.title: Hospital Administration Career in India: Salary & Courses
seo.description: Hospital Administration career guide for India — MHA courses, salary and hospital operations careers.

faqs.question: What does a Hospital Administrator do?
faqs.answer: They manage hospital operations, quality compliance and patient services.

faqs.question: Do I need a medical degree?
faqs.answer: No — BHA/MHA graduates manage hospitals; MBBS + MHA is one route among many.

env: Hospital chains and standalone hospitals; operations-heavy

name: Speech-Language Pathology
title: Speech-Language Pathologist
introduction: Speech-Language Pathologists help people with speech, language and swallowing disorders — from children with delays to stroke patients relearning to speak.

workNature.description: SLPs assess speech disorders, run therapy sessions and support families.

eligibility: BASLP degree (Bachelor of Audiology & Speech-Language Pathology)

stats.futureOutlook: Awareness of speech therapy and autism intervention is growing rapidly in India — BASLP graduates are in short supply.

steps.title: BASLP
steps.description: 4-year degree from RCI-recognised institutes (AIISH Mysore etc.).

steps.title: M.Sc Specialisation
steps.description: Specialise in speech or language disorders.

seo.title: Speech-Language Pathology Career in India: BASLP, Salary & Scope
seo.description: Speech-Language Pathology career guide for India — BASLP course, salary and therapy careers.

faqs.question: What does a Speech-Language Pathologist do?
faqs.answer: They assess and treat speech, language and swallowing disorders.

faqs.question: Is BASLP a good course?
faqs.answer: Yes — demand exceeds supply, with roles in hospitals, schools and tele-therapy.

env: Hospitals, speech-hearing institutes, schools and early-intervention centres

name: Clinical Data Management
title: Clinical Data Manager
introduction: Clinical Data Managers ensure the data from medical trials is clean, accurate and ready for regulatory submission — a critical behind-the-scenes role in drug development.
whoShouldPursue: Life science graduates who like data
Those seeking pharma careers without lab work

workNature.description: Clinical data managers build trial databases, clean data and resolve queries for regulatory submission.

stats.futureOutlook: India is a global hub for clinical data management — CROs hire continuously, and remote roles for US/European trials are common.

seo.title: Clinical Data Management Career in India: Salary & Scope
seo.description: Clinical Data Management career guide for India — courses, salary and CRO careers.

faqs.question: What does a Clinical Data Manager do?
faqs.answer: They ensure clinical trial data is clean, complete and ready for regulatory submission.

faqs.question: Is this a remote-friendly career?
faqs.answer: Yes — many CDM roles for US/European trials are remote.

deg: B.Pharm/B.Sc Life Sciences + clinical data management certification

name: Regulatory Affairs
title: Regulatory Affairs Officer
introduction: Regulatory Affairs Officers get drugs and medical devices approved by regulators like CDSCO and USFDA. They prepare the scientific dossiers that prove products are safe and effective.

workNature.description: Regulatory affairs officers prepare dossiers, file with regulators and track approvals.

stats.futureOutlook: Indian pharma exports require global regulatory expertise — USFDA and EU filing specialists are consistently in demand.

steps.title: RA Certification
steps.description: Add regulatory affairs certification and experience.

seo.title: Regulatory Affairs Career in India: Salary, Courses & Scope
seo.description: Regulatory Affairs career guide for India — courses, salary and pharma regulatory careers.

faqs.question: What does a Regulatory Affairs Officer do?
faqs.answer: They prepare and file regulatory dossiers to get drugs approved by authorities.

faqs.question: Which degree is needed?
faqs.answer: B.Pharm/M.Pharm is the standard route.

env: Pharma and medical device companies; office-based

name: Pharmacovigilance
title: Drug Safety Associate
introduction: Pharmacovigilance professionals monitor the safety of medicines after they reach the market — processing adverse event reports and protecting patients worldwide.

workNature.description: Drug safety associates process adverse event cases, code medical terms and submit safety reports.

stats.futureOutlook: Every pharma company needs drug safety teams for global compliance — India is a major PV delivery hub with night shifts for US/EU markets.

seo.title: Pharmacovigilance Career in India: Salary, Courses & Scope
seo.description: Pharmacovigilance career guide for India — courses, salary and drug safety careers.

faqs.question: What does a Pharmacovigilance professional do?
faqs.answer: They monitor medicine safety by processing adverse event reports and submitting safety data.

faqs.question: Is pharmacovigilance a good career?
faqs.answer: Yes — India is a global PV hub with steady demand and remote options.

env: Pharma companies and CROs; office-based with global team hours

name: Medical Coding
title: Medical Coder
introduction: Medical Coders convert diagnoses and procedures into standard codes (ICD-10, CPT) for billing and records. It is one of the fastest entry routes into healthcare careers for life science graduates.
whoShouldPursue: Life science graduates seeking quick employment

workNature.description: Medical coders assign diagnosis and procedure codes to patient records for billing and documentation.

stats.futureOutlook: US healthcare outsourcing to India keeps medical coding demand steady, and certified coders (CPC) progress to auditors and managers quickly.

steps.title: CPC Certification
steps.description: AAPC CPC certification for better roles.

seo.title: Medical Coding Career in India: CPC Certification, Salary & Jobs
seo.description: Medical Coding career guide for India — CPC certification, salary and remote jobs.

faqs.question: What does a Medical Coder do?
faqs.answer: They convert medical diagnoses and procedures into standard codes for billing.

faqs.question: Is CPC certification necessary?
faqs.answer: CPC certification significantly improves salary and role options.

env: HIM companies, hospitals and US healthcare BPOs; night shifts for US clients

name: Genetic Counseling
title: Genetic Counsellor
introduction: Genetic Counsellors help families understand genetic test results and inheritance risks — explaining complex science with compassion during difficult decisions.
whoShouldPursue: Those drawn to genetics and ethics

workNature.description: Genetic counsellors assess family history, explain test results and counsel on inheritance risks.

stats.futureOutlook: Genetic testing is becoming routine in prenatal and cancer care in India — trained counsellors are scarce and demand is growing fast.

seo.title: Genetic Counselling Career in India: Salary, Courses & Scope
seo.description: Genetic Counselling career guide for India — courses, salary and genetics clinic careers.

faqs.question: What does a Genetic Counsellor do?
faqs.answer: They help families understand genetic risks and test results.

faqs.question: Is this a new field in India?
faqs.answer: Yes and growing — genetic testing adoption is creating counsellor demand.

deg: B.Sc Life Sciences + M.Sc Genetic Counselling (increasingly required)
env: Hospitals, diagnostic labs and prenatal clinics

name: Microbiology
title: Microbiologist
introduction: Microbiologists study bacteria, viruses and fungi — identifying infections, ensuring food safety and supporting antibiotic research. They work in labs protecting public health.
whoShouldPursue: Biology students who love lab work

workNature.description: Microbiologists culture microbes, run sensitivity tests and maintain lab quality standards.

stats.futureOutlook: Antimicrobial resistance and food safety regulations keep microbiologists in demand across diagnostics and industry QC labs.

seo.title: Microbiology Career in India: Salary, Courses & Scope
seo.description: Microbiology career guide for India — courses, salary and lab careers.

faqs.question: What does a Microbiologist do?
faqs.answer: They study microorganisms — identifying infections and ensuring safety in labs and industry.

faqs.question: Where do microbiologists work?
faqs.answer: Diagnostic labs, pharma QC, food industry and research institutes.

env: Diagnostic labs, pharma QC, food industry and research labs

name: Marine Biology
title: Marine Biologist
introduction: Marine Biologists study ocean life — from coral reefs to whales — conducting field research and conservation work along coastlines and deep seas.

workNature.description: Marine biologists survey habitats, collect samples and analyse ecosystem data, often with diving work.

stats.futureOutlook: Blue economy initiatives and coastal conservation projects are creating research and NGO roles for marine biologists in India.

seo.title: Marine Biology Career in India: Salary, Courses & Scope
seo.description: Marine Biology career guide for India — courses, salary and conservation careers.

faqs.question: What does a Marine Biologist do?
faqs.answer: They study ocean organisms and ecosystems through field research and conservation work.

faqs.question: Do I need diving certification?
faqs.answer: For most field roles, yes — dive experience is highly valued.

deg: M.Sc Marine Biology (field and diving experience valued)
env: Coastal research stations, conservation NGOs and institutes; field and dive work

name: Intellectual Property Rights
title: Intellectual Property Rights Specialist
introduction: IPR Specialists protect innovations — filing patents, prosecuting trademarks and advising companies on intellectual property strategy. Science graduates with law knowledge are highly valued.

workNature.description: IPR specialists draft patent applications, prosecute trademarks and conduct prior-art searches.

stats.futureOutlook: India's innovation ecosystem files more patents every year — patent professionals with science backgrounds are in chronic short supply.

steps.title: Science/Law Degree
steps.description: B.Sc/B.Tech plus LLB, or law degree with tech interest.

steps.title: Patent Agent Exam
steps.description: Indian Patent Office patent agent examination.

seo.title: Intellectual Property Rights Career in India: Salary & Path
seo.description: IPR career guide for India — patent agent exam, salary and IP law careers.

faqs.question: What does an IPR Specialist do?
faqs.answer: They draft patents, prosecute trademarks and advise on intellectual property strategy.

faqs.question: Can science graduates enter IPR?
faqs.answer: Yes — science backgrounds are preferred, with the patent agent exam as the gateway.

env: IP law firms, corporate IP teams and LPOs; science graduates highly valued
